name: Johnny Awesome
summary: Johnny Awesome is a self-absorbed blood elf hunter known for his vanity and petulant attitude. Flaunting flashy gear and dramatic complaints, he is infamous among travelers for demanding others handle menial chores on his behalf.

sections.title: A Vainglorious Adventurer
sections.body: Adorned in immaculate equipment and accompanied by striking beasts, Johnny Awesome carries himself with an insufferable sense of entitlement. Rather than getting his own hands dirty in the field, he prefers to delegate unpleasant tasks to passing adventurers, constantly fretting over his personal comfort, his status, and the well-being of his lavish mounts.

faq.answer: He is an arrogant blood elf hunter whose exaggerated self-regard and vanity lead him to boss other wanderers around rather than face hardships himself.

faq.q: Why is he treated as a joke?
faq.answer: Johnny represents a caricature of entitled, overdressed adventurers who possess exceptional gear but refuse to perform basic legwork or exert genuine effort.

faq.q: What companions does Johnny Awesome have?
faq.answer: Johnny is recognized for keeping a companion spirit beast frostsaber named Dazzle, alongside prized steeds such as his mount named Twinkles.

angles.text: True hunters bond with the wild and respect the stalking of prey, making Johnny Awesome's pampered petulance and squeamish behavior an embarrassment to the craft.
Johnny represents the more flamboyant and self-involved tendencies found among high-born elven wanderers, often grating on the pragmatic sensibilities of the Horde.
